sn46.24:1.1: “Bhikkhus, when one attends carelessly, unarisen sensual desire arises and arisen sensual desire increases and expands;
sn46.24:1.2: when one attends carelessly, unarisen ill will arises and arisen ill will increases and expands;
sn46.24:1.3: when one attends carelessly, unarisen sloth and torpor arise and arisen sloth and torpor increase and expand;
sn46.24:1.4: when one attends carelessly, unarisen restlessness and remorse arise and arisen restlessness and remorse increase and expand;
sn46.24:1.5: when one attends carelessly, unarisen doubt arises and arisen doubt increases and expands.
sn46.24:1.6: Also, the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness does not arise and the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness ceases … the unarisen enlightenment factor of equanimity does not arise and the arisen enlightenment factor of equanimity ceases.
sn46.24:2.1: “When one attends carefully, bhikkhus, unarisen sensual desire does not arise and arisen sensual desire is abandoned.
sn46.24:2.2: When one attends carefully, unarisen ill will …
sn46.24:2.5: doubt does not arise and arisen doubt is abandoned.
sn46.24:3.1: Also, the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness arises and the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness comes to fulfilment by development … the unarisen enlightenment factor of equanimity arises and the arisen enlightenment factor of equanimity comes to fulfilment by development.”
